guides.title: e-Passport Application
guides.overview: The e-Passport is Bangladesh's biometric, machine-readable travel document issued by the Department of Immigration and Passports. It contains an electronic chip with the holder's biometric data. All Bangladeshi citizens can apply online through the official portal and complete enrollment at designated centers across the country.

guides.title: National ID Card Services
guides.overview: The National ID (NID) card is the primary identity document for all Bangladeshi citizens aged 18 and above. Issued by the Bangladesh Election Commission's NID Wing, it is required for voter registration, opening bank accounts, obtaining passports, SIM registration, and accessing various government services. Smart NID cards with biometric data are now being issued.

steps.title: Visit NID Wing Portal
steps.description: Go to nidw.gov.bd and select the appropriate service — new voter registration, NID correction, duplicate NID, or voter area migration.

steps.title: Fill Application Form
steps.description: Complete the NID application form with personal details including name, parents' information, date of birth, present and permanent address, and educational qualification.

steps.title: Submit Biometric Data
steps.description: Visit your designated local Election Office (Upazila/Thana) to submit biometric data including fingerprints, iris scan, and photograph. Bring all required original documents for verification.

steps.title: Collect NID Card
steps.description: After verification and processing, collect your NID card from the designated office. You can check your application status online at nidw.gov.bd. Smart NID cards are delivered to the local office.

guides.title: BRTA Online Services
guides.overview: The Bangladesh Road Transport Authority (BRTA) provides a range of vehicle and transport-related services through its online BRTA Service Portal (BSP). Citizens can register for driving licenses, vehicle registration, fitness certificates, tax tokens, route permits, and more through the BSP portal available at bsp.brta.gov.bd.

steps.title: Create BSP Account
steps.description: Visit bsp.brta.gov.bd and click 'Registration' to create a new account. Provide your NID number, mobile number, and email address. Verify your account through the OTP sent to your mobile.

citations.quoted_text: BRTA Service Portal (BSP) will be available from 8:00am to 10:00pm (Bangladesh Standard Time)

steps.title: Log In to BSP Portal
steps.description: Log in using your registered mobile number and password at bsp.brta.gov.bd/login. The portal is available daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM Bangladesh Standard Time.

steps.title: Select Service
steps.description: From the BSP dashboard, select the service you need — driving license, vehicle registration, fitness certificate, tax token, route permit, or other available services.

steps.title: Pay Fees Online
steps.description: Pay the applicable government fees through the portal. Use the BRTA Fee Calculator at bsp.brta.gov.bd/feeCalculator to check fees for your specific service before applying.

citations.page_title: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority - Official Website

steps.title: Book Appointment & Visit Office
steps.description: Book an appointment at your preferred BRTA office through the portal. Visit the office on the scheduled date with all required original documents for verification and processing.

guides.title: Driving License Services
guides.overview: BRTA issues driving licenses for various vehicle categories through the BSP portal. The process involves obtaining a learning license first, followed by written and practical examinations. Smart card driving licenses are issued upon successful completion. Both professional and non-professional categories are available.

steps.title: Apply on BSP Portal
steps.description: Log in to bsp.brta.gov.bd, select 'Driving License' from the services menu, choose the license category (professional or non-professional), and fill in the application form with your personal and vehicle category details.

citations.page_title: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority - Official Website

steps.title: Pay Fees & Get Learning License
steps.description: Pay the learning license fee online through the BSP portal. After fee payment, book an appointment to visit the BRTA office for biometric enrollment. Your learning license will be issued after verification.

steps.title: Written Examination
steps.description: After the mandatory learning period (minimum 30 days with learning license), appear for the written examination on traffic rules and road signs at the designated BRTA office.

steps.title: Practical Driving Test
steps.description: Pass the practical driving test at the BRTA test track. The test evaluates your ability to control the vehicle, follow traffic signals, and perform basic maneuvers.

steps.title: Collect Smart Card License
steps.description: Upon passing both exams, your smart card driving license will be prepared. Collect it from the BRTA office or receive delivery notification via SMS.

guides.title: Vehicle Registration Services
guides.overview: All motor vehicles operating in Bangladesh must be registered with BRTA. The registration process is handled through the BSP portal and includes document verification, fee payment, vehicle inspection, and issuance of a registration certificate with number plate. Registration is required for new, reconditioned, and imported vehicles.

steps.title: Apply on BSP Portal
steps.description: Log in to bsp.brta.gov.bd, select 'Vehicle Registration' from the services menu, and fill in the application form with vehicle details including make, model, chassis number, engine number, and CC.

steps.title: Submit Documents & Pay Fees
steps.description: Upload required documents including purchase invoice, customs clearance papers, insurance, and owner's NID/TIN. Pay the registration fees online through the portal based on vehicle type and engine CC.

steps.title: Vehicle Inspection
steps.description: Bring the vehicle to the designated BRTA inspection center on the appointed date. The vehicle will be inspected for compliance with safety and emission standards.

steps.title: Collect Registration Certificate
steps.description: After successful inspection and verification, the registration certificate and number plate will be issued. Collect from the BRTA office or receive notification for delivery.

guides.title: Vehicle Fitness Certificate
guides.overview: A Vehicle Fitness Certificate is a mandatory document certifying that a motor vehicle meets the safety and roadworthiness standards set by BRTA. All registered vehicles must obtain and renew their fitness certificate periodically. The process involves applying online through the BSP portal and presenting the vehicle for physical inspection.

steps.title: Apply on BSP Portal
steps.description: Log in to bsp.brta.gov.bd, select 'Fitness Certificate' from the services menu, enter your vehicle registration number, and submit the application for new issuance or renewal.

steps.description: Pay the fitness certificate fees online through the BSP portal. The fee varies based on vehicle type and category.

steps.title: Vehicle Inspection
steps.description: Take your vehicle to the designated BRTA inspection center on the appointed date. The vehicle will be checked for brakes, lights, emissions, steering, tires, and overall roadworthiness. Upon passing, the fitness certificate will be issued.

guides.title: Vehicle Tax Token
guides.overview: The Vehicle Tax Token is an annual road tax payment certificate required for all registered motor vehicles in Bangladesh. It must be renewed annually and is required for vehicle fitness certificate renewal. The tax token can be obtained and renewed online through the BSP portal.

steps.description: Log in to bsp.brta.gov.bd, select 'Tax Token' from the services menu, and enter your vehicle registration number to initiate the tax token application or renewal.

steps.description: Pay the annual road tax fee online through the BSP portal. The amount varies based on vehicle type, engine CC, and seating capacity.

steps.title: Download Tax Token

guides.title: e-TIN Registration
guides.overview: Register for an electronic Taxpayer Identification Number (e-TIN) through the National Board of Revenue's online portal. e-TIN is required for filing income tax returns, opening bank accounts, and many other financial transactions in Bangladesh.

steps.title: Visit the e-TIN Portal
steps.description: Go to the NBR e-TIN registration portal at secure.incometax.gov.bd and click on 'Registration' to begin the process.

steps.title: Register with NID
steps.description: Enter your National ID (NID) number, date of birth, and complete the CAPTCHA verification. The system will fetch your personal information from the NID database.

steps.title: Fill Application Form
steps.description: Complete the registration form with your personal details, address, income source information, and upload a passport-size photo. Provide your mobile number and email for verification.

steps.title: Get e-TIN Certificate
steps.description: After successful submission, your 12-digit e-TIN will be generated immediately. Download and print the e-TIN certificate for your records.

required_documents.description: Valid NID number required for identity verification

required_documents.description: Recent photograph in digital format (JPEG/PNG)

required_documents.description: Valid email for account verification and correspondence

fees.description: e-TIN registration is completely free through the online portal

guides.title: Birth Registration
guides.overview: Register a birth and obtain a birth certificate through Bangladesh's online birth and death registration system (BDRIS). Birth registration is mandatory and required for school admission, passport application, and other government services.

steps.title: Visit BDRIS Portal
steps.description: Go to bdris.gov.bd and click on 'Online Birth Registration Application' to start the process. You can also apply through your local Union Parishad, Pourashava, or City Corporation office.

steps.title: Fill Application Form
steps.description: Complete the birth registration form with details including: child's name, date and place of birth, parents' names and NID numbers, permanent and present address.

steps.title: Submit Supporting Documents
steps.description: Submit the application along with required documents to the local registrar office (Union Parishad, Pourashava, or City Corporation).

steps.title: Verification
steps.description: The local registrar verifies the submitted information. For births within 45 days, verification is typically straightforward. Late registrations may require additional documentation.

steps.title: Collect Certificate
steps.description: After approval, collect the birth certificate from the registrar office or download it online from bdris.gov.bd using the registration number.

guides.title: Police Clearance Certificate
guides.overview: Apply for a Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) required for visa applications, immigration, foreign employment, and other purposes. The PCC confirms that the applicant has no criminal record in Bangladesh.

steps.title: Create Account on PCC Portal
steps.description: Visit pcc.police.gov.bd and create an account using your email address and mobile number. Verify your account through the OTP sent to your mobile.

steps.title: Fill Application Form
steps.description: Log in and fill the PCC application form with personal details, passport information, purpose of PCC, and destination country. Upload required documents including passport copy and photographs.

steps.title: Pay Fees
steps.description: Pay the application fee online through the portal using mobile banking (bKash, Nagad), internet banking, or card payment. Fee is ৳500 for regular processing or ৳2,000 for urgent processing.

steps.title: Biometric Enrollment
steps.description: Visit the designated police station or PCC center for biometric data capture (fingerprints and photograph). Bring your original passport and NID.

steps.title: Collect PCC
steps.description: After background verification, collect your PCC from the issuing office. Regular processing takes 7-15 working days; urgent processing takes 3-5 working days.

guides.title: Trade License
guides.overview: Obtain or renew a trade license for your business from the local City Corporation or Municipality. A trade license is mandatory for all businesses operating in Bangladesh.

steps.title: Collect Application Form
steps.description: Obtain the trade license application form from your local City Corporation, Pourashava, or Union Parishad office. Some City Corporations also offer online application through their portals.

steps.title: Submit Application with Documents
steps.description: Fill the application form and submit it along with all required documents including NID, TIN certificate, photographs, rent agreement or ownership proof, and trade association membership certificate.

steps.title: Inspection and Verification
steps.description: The local authority may conduct an inspection of your business premises to verify the information provided in the application.

steps.title: Pay Fees and Collect License
steps.description: Pay the applicable trade license fee (varies by business type, size, and location) and collect your trade license. Licenses are typically valid for one year and must be renewed annually.

guides.agency_name: Registrar of Joint Stock Companies and Firms (RJSC)
guides.title: Company Registration
guides.overview: Register a new company or firm with the Registrar of Joint Stock Companies and Firms (RJSC) through the online portal. Company registration is required for limited companies, partnerships, and trade organizations.

steps.title: Name Clearance
steps.description: Apply for name clearance through the RJSC online portal (roc.portal.gov.bd). Submit up to 3 proposed company names. The registrar will approve one name within 2-3 working days.

steps.title: Prepare MOA and AOA
steps.description: Prepare the Memorandum of Association (MOA) and Articles of Association (AOA) with the approved company name. These documents define the company's objectives, capital structure, and internal rules.

steps.title: Submit Online Application
steps.description: Complete the online registration form on the RJSC portal. Upload all required documents including MOA, AOA, Form XII (registered office address), directors' information, and shareholder details.

steps.title: Pay Registration Fees
steps.description: Pay the registration fee online. The fee varies based on the authorized capital of the company. Additional stamp duty and filing fees may apply.

steps.title: Collect Certificate of Incorporation
steps.description: After verification and approval, the Certificate of Incorporation is issued. Download it from the portal or collect from the RJSC office.

guides.title: E-Porcha / Land Records
guides.overview: Access and download land records (porcha/khatian) through the e-Porcha digital land records system. You can search for RS, SA, City Jordip, and BS/BRS records online.

steps.title: Visit e-Porcha Portal
steps.description: Go to eporcha.gov.bd and select the type of land record you want to search: RS Porcha, SA Porcha, City Jordip Porcha, or BS/BRS Porcha.

steps.title: Search by Location Details
steps.description: Enter the search criteria: Division, District, Upazila, Mouza, and either the Khatian Number or Plot (Dag) Number. You can also search by owner name in some record types.

steps.title: View and Download Records
steps.description: View the land record details on screen. You can download or print the porcha for your records. The online record serves as a reference; certified copies must be obtained from the local land office.

required_documents.label: Mouza Name
required_documents.description: Name of the mouza (revenue village) where the land is located

required_documents.label: JL Number
required_documents.description: Jurisdiction List (JL) number of the mouza

required_documents.label: Khatian Number
required_documents.description: Record of Rights (khatian) number, if known

required_documents.label: Dag/Plot Number
required_documents.description: Plot number of the land parcel, if known

fees.label: Free Online Search
fees.description: Searching and viewing land records on eporcha.gov.bd is free of charge

fees.label: Certified Copy: Fees Apply
fees.description: Obtaining a certified copy from the land office requires payment of applicable government fees
